about_the_game:
Descend into the depths in Breath Bound, a 2D cooperative puzzle game about trust, timing, and survival. Two divers are tethered by a single oxygen tank, forcing players to share their lifeline as they make their way from the ocean floor toward the surface.

Pass the tank, manage your oxygen, and solve intricate underwater puzzles that demand teamwork and precision, all the while collecting shimmering jewels throughout the oceans caverns.

Collect with caution, some treasures are best left behind...
